curations.textual_observation: Ezekiel promises restoration, a new heart, and a new spirit; this passage is grouped with new-covenant hope in the CKL prophecy cluster.
curations.uncertainty: Ezekiel 36:24-28 does not use the Hebrew term berit (“covenant”); the relationship is a thematic grouping, not an explicit covenant formula or a direct quotation.
curations.why: Ezekiel promises restoration, a new heart, and a new spirit; this passage is grouped with new-covenant hope in the CKL prophecy cluster. This gives readers a passage-anchored connection from New Covenant Prophecy to Ezekiel while preserving the authored direction.
